items.meta_title: Reach Local Devices While on a VPN | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Keep printers, TVs and other devices on your local network reachable while the VPN is on. Split local network in VpnHood!.
items.title: Split local network
items.lead: Keep printers, TVs and other devices on your local network reachable while the VPN is on.
items.shot_alt: The Split local network screen in the VpnHood! app
items.how_desc: Traffic to local addresses is sent directly instead of into the tunnel, so the devices around you stay visible without turning the VPN off.
items.when_desc: Casting to a TV, printing, a NAS, a smart home hub, anything that lives on the same Wi-Fi as you.
items.cost_desc: Local traffic is exposed to the local network, which is exactly how it was before the VPN. On public Wi-Fi you may prefer to leave this off.
